name: Sendgrid
shortInfo: SendGrid is a Denver, Colorado-based customer communication platform for transactional and marketing email.
brief: SendGrid is a customer communication platform that helps businesses send transactional and marketing emails. SendGrid offers email delivery management, ISP monitoring, and reporting features.
about:
The Send Grid Reverse ETL connector enables streaming data from a user determined warehouse to the Send Grid platform in an automated manner.

Check more about SendGrid api documentation [here](https://docs.sendgrid.com/api-reference/how-to-use-the-sendgrid-v3-api/authentication).
availableSync:
[Contact](https://docs.datachannel.co/getting-started/1.0.0/reverse_etl/destinations_retl/sendgrid/syncs/contact.html)

This sync can be used to upload contact details from your data warehouse to the Send Grid platform.

[Mail](https://docs.datachannel.co/getting-started/1.0.0/reverse_etl/destinations_retl/sendgrid/syncs/mail.html)

This sync can be used to upload mail details from your data warehouse to the Send Grid platform.
